description: This file defines an abstract exception class `AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException` used in the Fineract project to represent resource-not-found errors. It extends `AbstractPlatformException` and is intended for inheritance by concrete exceptions indicating missing resources.

classes.name: AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException
classes.description: An abstract class representing a specific type of platform exception indicating that a requested resource was not found. It extends `AbstractPlatformException` and provides a constructor to set error messages and codes.

methods.name: AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a globalisation message code, a default user message, and optional message arguments. Calls the superclass constructor.
